newsitem.title: USA: USA Detergents faces 2nd shareholder suit.
newsitem.headline: USA Detergents faces 2nd shareholder suit.

text.p: Lawfirms representing a group of people who bought USA Detergents Corp securities said on Tuesday that they had filed a class action suit on May 19 charging the company with issuing false public statements.
The purchasers involved in the case bought securities between February 7 and April 24, the firms said in a joint statement.
The case alleges that the company and some of its officers misrepresented the true condition of the company's business, inflating stock prices.
The lawsuit does not specify the amount of monetary damages being sought from USA Detergents, which makes laundry and household cleaning products.
No one was immediately available at the company to comment.
The purchaseres are being represented by the Law Offices of Bernard M. Gross, P.C. and Trujillo Rodriguez & Richards, LLC.

Ealier this month USA Detergents said it would vigorously defend itself against another shareholder suit filed on May 7. That suit alleged that the company failed to disclose adverse information about its financial health in a timely fashion.
